misses_and_conditions: 100BASE-TX amplitude needs WT53-c: CASCODE raised to about 4.2 V by a wired TX pump (<= 4.6 V incl. transients, never ahead of VDD, 0 V unpowered). Pad delivers 35.5 / 39.5 mA ss / tt at 4.2 V (26.9 / 34.5 with the gate at VDD). 950 mV at the RJ45 is wired TX's open confirmation.
Board rule B54: magnetics centre tap (and any DC level on WIRE_TX_P/N) <= VDD + 0.30 V; CT not powered while the chip is unpowered (or limited to < 1 mA) (PC-71).
Pad C 3.214 of 3.223 pF: 9 fF left; no metal may be added on PAD / TU nets.
CDM 2 A vdd+ (pad positive vs supply) incomplete under the PULSE source; bounded at 3.92 V by the partial run.
HBM 1 kV vdd+ bounded by a DC sweep, not a complete transient.
EM static 30-40 mA one-leg overs (B100 / P100) apply only with the termination on, which is forbidden in 100BASE-TX (validator forbids TX_EN_TERM at 100BASE-TX codes).
No-static-drive rule (PC-65): 100BASE-TX must not hold a static level on one leg; enforced by wired TX with a bounded timeout.
TERM_DISCHARGE 2 x 20 um ppolyf_u_1k (PC-61): pending wired TX's ack.
em_check does not yet cover PAD bond -> resistor heads or per-unit head-A straps (review-a16 F1; PAD trunk numbers above are from the reviewer's netres).
